title: algolia nbHits giving different count for different replicas
body: sometimes nbHits gives proper count on same index and sometimes not. Count for replica indices also differs for the same query.  Please help me to find the solution.

comments.body: Number of hits is an approximation usually. Can you give your appID/indexName so that we can debug this? A reproducible version with your code would be helpful too, since we can then see on which level the problem occurs

Hello Haroenv,
Appld - WJNZFCQTYW
indexName - staging_zoodel_products_seller(default index)
ReplicaIndex - staging_zoodel_products_popular_slave (To show popularity with different ranking)

Please refer this url  http://staging.zoodel.com/en/products . Here you can see number of products(nbHits) are different sometime.  Let me know if you need more details.

Thank you for your help.

Hey, seems like this is getting quite into detail and I can't replicate the differing count. I always see 33 333 results. Can you send an email to [support@algolia.com](mailto:support@algolia.com) with two queries that should have the same number of result but don't? You can look in the devtools tab, and "copy as curl" the two `queries` results that have different results, but shouldn't. 

I'll close this issue since I don't think it's related to instantsearch.js, but rather something else in the API call.

Hey, If you check sortby : popularity/relevancy one by one, then you can see the different count. Here I am using replica index to show result for popularity having just different ranking. 
In code I am just passing indexname on change of "sortby" field.

Yes, this is using algolia API call , not instantsearch.js.

Can you give detailed information on how exactly you're calling the API and send this via email, I can't replicate this on your side, but maybe a minimal example will give us more insight in what happens that causes this disparity between number of hits.
